user.title: Sungrow — Connection Mode
user.description:
Choose how to connect to your Sungrow inverter.

**Both** (recommended): Uses the iSolarCloud API for historical data and Modbus for real-time readings.
**API only**: Cloud-only, no local network access needed.
**Modbus only**: LAN-only, no cloud account needed.

api_credentials.title: iSolarCloud API Credentials
api_credentials.description: Enter your iSolarCloud OAuth2 app credentials. Register at [{portal_url}]({portal_url}) (approval takes ~1-2 days).

api_authorize.title: Authorize iSolarCloud
api_authorize.description:
1. Open this URL in your browser:
   **{auth_url}**
2. Log in and authorize the app.
3. Copy the authorization code from the redirect URL and paste it below.

⚠ The code expires in ~5 minutes.

modbus.title: Modbus Connection
modbus.description:
Configure the direct connection to your Sungrow inverter.

For SSL/TLS: Enable 'Use SSL' and optionally provide a certificate file path for self-signed certificates. Leave 'Verify SSL' disabled for self-signed certs.

ihm.title: iHomeManager (optional)
ihm.description:
The Sungrow iHomeManager (iHM) provides system-wide power flow data: total load, grid connection point, battery aggregates. Enable this if you have an iHM on your network.

Default slave ID is 247. Ports 502, 503, or 504 may be used (each supports only 1 connection).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect — check credentials or network
error.invalid_auth: Authorization failed — code may be expired
